card.name: Patient counts inside large numbers
card.fires_on: The space or thousands comma just before or inside a large patient count, such as 16,029 or 2,947, in trial results. It fires where a group size is being written out.

modes.label: Comma inside a number
modes.description: The thousands comma partway through a large patient count before the group name.
modes.example: compared to 0.24% among 16<<,>>029 placebo-treated patients, representing

modes.label: Space before a count
modes.description: The space right before a number giving the size of a study population.
modes.example: -alone ancillary study, a population of<< >>2,947 hysterectom

card.writes: It pushes down words like data and statistics, so the next text is a number rather than a word about data.
card.plain: It fires while a large patient count is being written out, just before or inside the number.
